description: WAARE 100W Foldable Solar Panel Charger with USB Ports, Waterproof Portable Solar Charger for Smartphones, Camping & Travel - Distributed/Packaged by Waaree. Product Details: WAARE 100W Foldable Solar Panel, engineered for outdoor adventures, camping, RV trips, emergency backup, and off-grid applications. Built with high-performance M6 P-Type PERC Bifacial half-cut solar cells, this portable solar panel delivers reliable energy conversion while maintaining a lightweight and compact foldable design for easy transportation and storage. Designed for durability in harsh outdoor environments, the panel features a premium ETFE polymer surface that offers superior weather resistance, UV protection, and long-lasting performance. The IP68-rated junction box and MC4-compatible connectors provide excellent protection against dust, water, and environmental exposure, making it ideal for camping, trekking, hiking, caravans, and emergency preparedness. With a maximum power output of 100W, operating voltage of 20.52V, and operating current of 4.90A, the panel efficiently charges compatible power stations, batteries, USB charging devices, smartphones, tablets, and other portable electronics when used with a suitable solar charge controller or power station. The foldable design reduces the panel dimensions to just 350 x 720 mm for convenient carrying and storage, while expanding to 1040 x 720 mm for optimal solar energy collection. Weighing only 4 kg, it offers an excellent balance between portability and power generation. Backed by a 5-Year Power Output Warranty and a 2-Year Material & Workmanship Warranty (for non-roofing applications), the WAARE 100W Foldable Solar Panel is a dependable renewable energy solution for outdoor enthusiasts, travelers, and anyone seeking clean, sustainable power on the go.
